settings.headline:
A place to belong,
a people to grow with.
settings.copy: Gracehaven is a neighborhood church in the heart of the city — a community that gathers weekly, serves its neighbors, and walks with one another through every season of life.

trust_list.text: A church for every season of life
Open to everyone, wherever you are

settings.title: Faith that is
settings.intro: We keep the essentials central and hold the rest with grace. Here is the heart of what Gracehaven stands for.

features.title: Grace at the center
features.text: We believe we are loved by God not because of what we do, but because of who God is. Grace is the starting point of everything we teach and practice.

features.title: Scripture that shapes us
features.text: We read the Bible seriously and honestly — not as a rulebook, but as the story that forms our lives and our community.

features.title: A people, not a program
features.text: Church is not an event we attend but a family we belong to. Small groups, shared meals, and everyday friendship are the real work.

features.title: Sent to serve
features.text: We are not called to stay inside our walls. We serve our neighbors, care for the vulnerable, and welcome the stranger.

settings.title: Ways to
settings.intro: There are many doors into the Gracehaven family. Find the one that fits your season of life.

design.title: Sunday Worship
design.text: Two identical gatherings at 9:00 and 11:00 AM — contemporary worship, honest teaching, and a warm welcome. Kids' church runs alongside both.

design.title: Kids & Youth
design.text: Age-appropriate programs for infants through high school, staffed by trained volunteers who love what they do.

design.title: New Here? Start Here
design.text: A relaxed 20-minute welcome after the 11:00 service — coffee, a tour, and a chance to meet a few friendly faces.

build.title: Small Groups
build.text: Two dozen groups meet in homes across the city — by neighborhood, life stage, and interest. Find your people.

build.title: Prayer Night
build.text: Every Wednesday at 7:00 PM we gather to pray for one another, our city, and the world. All are welcome.

build.title: Bible Study
build.text: A midweek walk through Scripture with discussion and real questions — no prior knowledge needed, ever.

launch.title: Serve on a Team
launch.text: Worship, kids, hospitality, tech, and more — there is a place for your gifts. Serving is how we become family.

launch.title: Local Mission
launch.text: We partner with a dozen neighborhood ministries — from food distribution to after-school tutoring — and you can join them.

launch.title: Give & Support
launch.text: Your generosity funds our mission and our neighbors. Give online, in person, or by mail.

settings.title: Getting
settings.intro: Whether you are brand new or returning after a long time away, here is how to take your first steps at Gracehaven.

steps.title: Come as you are
steps.text: No dress code, no checklist, no pressure. Just show up to a Sunday gathering and see if it feels like home.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.text: Grab a coffee at the welcome table and meet a few people. We would love to learn your name.

steps.title: Find your people
steps.text: Join a small group or a serving team. This is where the church stops being a crowd and becomes a family.

steps.title: Grow at your pace
steps.text: Explore faith through teaching, community, and honest questions. There is no rush and no wrong way to grow.

settings.note: New to church? Start with the 11:00 service and the 'New Here' welcome — it is designed exactly for you.

settings.title: Forty years of
settings.intro: Gracehaven began as a handful of families in a living room. Here is how we grew into the church we are today.

events.title: A church is born
events.text: Twelve families begin meeting in a rented school gym, determined to be a church for their neighborhood.

events.title: Our first building
events.text: The congregation moves into the building we still call home, built by the hands of our own members.

events.title: Kids & youth flourish
events.text: We launch dedicated children's and youth ministries, and the next generation becomes central to our life.

events.title: Sent into the city
events.text: We plant our first neighborhood partnerships, committing to serve our city rather than just gather in it.

events.title: Still growing
events.text: Today more than 600 people call Gracehaven home, and we are still learning what it means to be a family.

settings.title: Give from a
settings.intro: Your giving makes our mission possible — from the lights on Sunday to the food we share with neighbors on Tuesday.
settings.quote: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

settings.title: We would love to
settings.intro: Visiting a new church can feel intimidating. We have tried to make it easy — here is everything you need to know before you come.

settings.title: We would love to
settings.intro: Questions, prayer requests, or just want to say hello? Send us a note and a real person will get back to you.

settings.blurb: A neighborhood church gathering weekly, serving our city, and walking with one another through every season of life since 1987.
